Whether the organization is currently operating
Registered legal name, e.g. Koninklijke Luchtvaart Maatschappij N.V. for KLM
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. NL

Controlled value from cv:airport-facility-type, verbatim from OurAirports 'type' column
Field elevation above mean sea level, in feet
Raw municipality string from source, retained alongside resolved servesCity
ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (OurAirports iso_region); denormalized, not its own dimension in phase 2
True if the stand has no boarding gate (bused/walked passengers)

Numeric/alphanumeric flight number suffix, e.g. '672' (carrier code comes from the marketing airline's iataCode)
Date this scheduled flight plan takes effect
Date this scheduled flight plan ends (absent = still in service)
7-char '0'/'1' bitstring, Monday-first, e.g. 1111100 for weekdays only
1-based ordinal position of this leg within its scheduled flight

Local time of day 'HH:MM' for this leg's scheduled arrival
Scheduled block time for this leg, in minutes
Great-circle distance in km, when known (derived from airport lat/long, not sourced directly)
The specific date this flight instance operates

Length of the delay in minutes

OpenSky ground speed, meters/second (native unit, not converted)

Mirrors canonical record_status (active|deprecated|suspended|historical); absence implies active
IATA equipment code, e.g. 789 (sourced from OpenFlights planes.dat)
e.g. Boeing, Airbus, Embraer -- split from planes.dat's single Name field
e.g. 787-9 -- manufacturer-name prefix removed from planes.dat's Name field
Controlled value from cv:aircraft-body-type (narrow-body|wide-body|regional); not present in OpenFlights, manually curated per family
Manufacturer/operator-published typical multi-class seating figure; not from OpenFlights
ICAO24 Mode-S hex address; separate property from PositionReportEvent's observedIcao24Hex
Number of seats in this cabin section

When the aircraft went out of service for this maintenance action

Whether attribution to the source is a licensing obligation
Whether publicly redistributed derived works must use a compatible license (e.g. ODbL)
